IITIIT (ISM) Dhanbad · Research internship Open

IIT (ISM) Winter Research Internship Scheme 2026

One-to-two-month winter research internship with IIT (ISM) Dhanbad faculty; separate long-term track for 6–12 months.

STIPEND / MONTH
₹5,000
Stipend details
₹5,000 per month for institute-funded Category I and II interns, for up to two months. Category III has no institute stipend.
Category I & II deadline
31 Oct 2026 (exact cutoff time not announced)
Format & location
In person · Dhanbad, Jharkhand
Who can apply
Category I: BTech students. Category II: MTech, MSc and MBA students (PG students already on a fellowship get no extra stipend). Category III (long-term, 6–12 months, NOC needed) is project- or self-funded.
Accommodation & support
Hostel available on payment, subject to availability · no travel support listed

Entry notes

  • Category III (long-term) closes 15 November 2026.
  • ₹500 non-refundable application fee; apply by email as a single PDF per the official notice.
